mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,attempts=attempts+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status<>'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE payment_outbox SET status='RETRY',attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL 5 SECOND) WHERE id=#{id}
